evidence: 2026-10-16 guest run: product page → 'Buy this' → gumroad.com/checkout; country, email and full name filled from vault tokens, Stripe Payment Element expiry/number/CVC filled in one batch, Pay clicked once, the verification test card was declined ('Your card was declined'). No order placed.
notes: Fixed-price digital product, no pay-what-you-want input, no shipping address. Guest checkout; no account needed. Price shows in the visitor's detected currency.
gotchas: The 'Buy this' link leaves the store host: the checkout form lives on gumroad.com/checkout, a single page with contact fields, the Stripe frame and Pay together.

Email (`input[type=email]`, identity email token), full name (`fieldset:has(legend:has-text("Full name")) input`, identity full_name token) and country (`select[id$="country"]` as a select, the address country token) are the only required non-card fields; no address or phone. Fill country first in its own call: it recomputes VAT and the total.
Field ids are React-generated (`:rN:-email`); match by type, legend or id suffix, never the full id.
Declare the total with `footer h4 + *` (reads e.g. 'CHF 2.69'); `:has` is refused in a hint.
Card fields sit in `iframe[title="Secure payment input frame"]`: `input[name=expiry]` first, then `input[name=number]` and `input[name=cvc]` back to back. Pay stays disabled until they are filled.

After the email fill, Stripe Link may show a one-time-code prompt inside the card frame for an email that has a Link account; the code is the account owner's. To pay by card instead, press Enter on `button[aria-label*="Close"]` in the card frame; the card fields stay filled.
Test card declined (2026-10-16): after Pay, `[role=alert]` reads 'Your card was declined' (the alert node is visually hidden; detect it with count, not visibility).
The page carries reCAPTCHA Enterprise (invisible); it did not challenge on 2026-10-16.
